reason: Both rightly refuse to invent a number or confirm readiness, but Response 2 is more usable for this team: it breaks 'error rate' into distinct error types, gives concrete sampling guidance (including the zero-errors-in-100 bound), offers ready-to-send procurement wording and defensible launch-page copy, and lays out a realistic two-week path.
